identificationModule.briefTitle: Continuation Trial Evaluating the Tolerability and Activity of FK228 in Patients That Completed Prior Study With FK228
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Open-Label Continuation Trial Evaluating the Tolerability and Activity of FK228 in Patients That Have Completed a Prior Clinical Study With FK228

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of extended treatment with FK228 in patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma or hormone refractory prostate cancer who have at least demonstrated stable disease on prior Fujisawa sponsored FK228 clinical trials.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a Phase II, non-randomized, open-label, single arm, continuation trial.

interventions.name: FK228 (romidepsin)
interventions.description: Patients were continued at the same dose of romidepsin as in the previous study, which could have been 13 mg/m2 or a reduced dose of 10 mg/m2, administered intravenously over 4 hours on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with adverse events

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the effect of depsipeptide therapy on performance status as measured by the Karnofsky score assessment
To evaluate the time to objective disease progression.

locations.facility: City of Hope National Medical Center
